title: Power Management Integrated Circuits
description: Modern power management integrated circuits (PMIC) design introduced comperhensively. Advanced topics in power management introduced, including linear regulators, digital linear regulators, switch-mode power converters, control schemes for DC-DC converters, compensation methods of DC-DC converters, power losses in DC-DC converters, switched capacitor converters, power converter modeling and simulation, design examples.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E4312 ) and ( ELEN E4361 )
raw_title_text: ELEN E6340 Power Management Integrated Circuits. 3.00 points .
